sentences.en: She was dumped by her boyfriend via a text message.
sentences.zh: 她被男友通过短信甩了。

sentences.en: "Will you go to Glasgow via Mallaig?" "Yes, I will."
sentences.zh: 你会取道马莱格去格拉斯哥吗？是的，我会。

sentences.en: This village can not be reached except via the river.
sentences.zh: 除了通过河流，这个村子无法到达。

senses.zh: 经由，经过（某一地方）；通过，借助于（某种手段或人）
